what_to_detect: An Amass resolution that places no +1/+1 counter (counters prevented) still counts as amassing: its when-you-do or amassed-dependent sub-ability still runs.
near_miss: An Amass spell or ability that leaves the stack without resolving, so the player does not amass.
record_fields: payload.events delayed_trigger_created or the sub-ability's events

what_to_detect: An Amass resolution that places no counter still designates the chosen Army as the amassed Army: a later clause reading the amassed Army's power uses that creature.
near_miss: An Amass spell or ability that leaves the stack without resolving, so there is no amassed Army.
record_fields: damage_dealt amount against the Army's power in the snapshot
